desc:
☕ Work to work at a coffee shop RP! At our City, you can order food, cook food, become a delivery driver, and eat food!
🍪 Cook and serve food, complete quests, and deliver meals to earn cash.

🤝 Team up with friends with vc in shifts and promotion sessions to gain experience and rank up faster.
🏢 Own the restaurant, promote staff, and unlock exclusive status as you climb the community ranks
🏠 Use earnings to purchase avatar accessories and own apartments
🏆 Use the !promote (@username) command without @ to promote others as MR+

🌟 Latest Update: Promote others to between Trainee - CEO as a CEO!
⭐ Join the group for promotions and bonuses.
👍 Like & Favourite to catch new events, updates, and promotions!
